sentences.l2: 清晨，我从城市的长途客运站出发，乘坐长途汽车回乡村老家。
sentences.l1: In the early morning, I set out from the city's long-distance bus station and took a long-distance bus back to my old home in the countryside.

sentences.l2: 客运站里人声嘈杂，电子屏幕不断提示晚点，我攥着车票，生怕错过这趟归途。
sentences.l1: The bus station was noisy with voices, the electronic screens kept announcing delays, and I clutched my ticket, afraid of missing this bus home.

sentences.l2: 汽车驶出城区后，窗外的楼房渐渐稀少，田野和河流依次展开。
sentences.l1: After the bus drove out of the urban area, the buildings outside the window gradually became sparse, and fields and rivers unfolded one after another.

sentences.l2: 为了赶在傍晚前到家，我特意买了最早的一班车。
sentences.l1: In order to get home before evening, I deliberately bought the earliest bus.

sentences.l2: 中途还要在小镇转车，因为直达老家的车一天只有一班。
sentences.l1: Along the way I also had to change buses in a small town, because there was only one direct bus to my old home each day.

sentences.l2: 转车时，我拖着行李穿过拥挤的站台，心里既有疲惫，也有期待。
sentences.l1: When changing buses, I dragged my luggage through the crowded platform, with both weariness and anticipation in my heart.

sentences.l2: 最后一段路并不长，却格外安静：石板路两旁是低矮的屋檐和刚插下的秧苗。
sentences.l1: The last stretch of road was not long, but it was exceptionally quiet: on both sides of the flagstone road were low eaves and freshly planted rice seedlings.

sentences.l2: 下车后，我看见母亲站在门口，灯光把她的影子拉得很长；远处传来几声犬吠，炊烟在屋顶上缓缓升起。
sentences.l1: After getting off, I saw my mother standing at the door, the light stretching her shadow very long; from the distance came a few barks of dogs, and cooking smoke was slowly rising above the roofs.

sentences.l2: 那一刻，长途奔波带来的倦意仿佛被乡下的夜风吹散了。
sentences.l1: At that moment, the fatigue brought by the long journey seemed to have been blown away by the country night wind.
